resourceContract.admission: D5 — Before live registration qualify existing NVIDIA route: A disables thinking with required tools; B disables thinking with named bash only after resolved A failure. First profile passing two probes wins before task outcomes. Four qualification wire attempts total, output 512, request timeout 300s/supervisor 310s, pacing 10s/concurrency one, USD 0.10. No UNKNOWN bypass, key rotation or capacity purchase.
resourceContract.transport: Reserve every wire attempt before fsynced INTENT/SEND_STARTED. Persist actual response hash/usage on SETTLED; documented NOT_ADMITTED releases reservation only, not wire count. UNKNOWN holds worst-case budget. Redact auth/cookies. No hidden retries.
resourceContract.backoff: Non-admission persists nextEligibleAt=max(now+min(60*2^retryIndex,3600),Retry-After)+seeded 0..5s jitter. Honor original deadline/wait cap; exit10 while waiting, zero early sends. Single owner/shared scheduler includes probes and both arms.
resourceContract.reconciliation: Append evidence-bound RECONCILED against original request/attempt hash once. Identical replay no-op; conflicting replay fails. UNKNOWN keeps reservation until proof or terminal deadline, never assumes zero charge.
resourceContract.resume: Fold durable journal before dispatch; finish RESULT_CAPTURED deterministic suffix without provider calls. Preserve attempts, active time and absolute deadlines. SEND_STARTED crash fences UNKNOWN. Kill only owned processes/containers and record cleanup errors.
resourceContract.handoff: Portable hash manifest covers journal, probes, responses, candidates, verification, Core traces, metrics and receipts. Rebuild current stage/request/deadline/reservations/missing facts; no secrets/absolute paths. Import can remap runtime paths only.
resourceContract.termination: Exit 0 completed facts/audit; 10 persisted wait; 11 unresolved provider; 12 resource exhausted; 2 invalid inputs; 3 missing prerequisite; 4 infrastructure failure. None is a value verdict. CLI status exposes required remaining executions, outstanding reservations, earliest retry and deadline. A blocked cohort can be retained as terminal and a separately authorized new cohort registered; never drop old charges.
resourceContract.journalSchema: Retain current hash-chained fsynced events.jsonl schema and single-owner lock. Unique identical event replay only; fold is authority, current.json projection only. Preserve profile, reservation, response, retry, terminal bindings.
transitionTable: REQUEST_INTENT -> SEND_STARTED (fsynced before wire), then SETTLED | NOT_ADMITTED | UNKNOWN. Ambiguous crash after SEND_STARTED -> UNKNOWN even if no wire actually left.

NOT_ADMITTED -> WAITING_PROVIDER without new semantic attempt if no agent steps executed and current driver can stop before query; otherwise end attempt with explicit reason. Every later launch counts toward maxAttemptsPerExecution; reject third launch.

UNKNOWN -> RECONCILED_SETTLED or RECONCILED_NOT_ADMITTED only with proof; unresolved -> TERMINAL_UNRESOLVED at deadline. Original UNKNOWN remains in journal and fold uses the one matching reconciliation.
RESULT_CAPTURED -> VERIFIED -> CORE_ADOPTED (EXHARNESS only) -> ATTEMPT_TERMINAL. Recovery performs missing deterministic suffix only; provider calls are not part of suffix.

WAITING_PROVIDER -> eligible ADMISSION only when now >= nextEligibleAt and all shared limits allow it; otherwise remain waiting or terminate exhausted. Any nonterminal -> resource terminal on absolute deadline.
resourceContract.recoveryTests: Fresh-process/fake-clock tests: 429 wait/early resume zero sends; disconnect UNKNOWN/fenced resume/proof reconciliation; captured-result adoption without new calls; growing portable export; conflicting reconciliation, third attempt, expired deadline and second owner rejection. Assert exact dispatch, budget and candidate identities.

qualification.selection: Two valid structured bash calls with settled usage/model attestation; first passing profile. Record every failure. No live cohort registration until qualification succeeds; bind qualification hash and selected profile. Shared campaign identity owns budgets across process/output restarts. No second cohort or semantic reroll automatically.

canary.gate: D16 — CANARY_OPERABILITY_V2: OPERABILITY, submissionRequired=false (telemetry). Nonce only in nonce.txt, never prompt. Require successful native read, exact tool result, FIRST successful marker write in strictly later assistant turn and exact disk marker; map tool call IDs to original SETTLED request/response and results; >=2 causal native turns. Shared file-backed evaluator register/live/audit. PASS needs complete capture/digest/measured timing, resolved wires and 4wire/50k/1200active seconds/USD5 caps. Submitted or journal-backed LimitsExceeded after full chain may PASS. Recovered settled malformed/truncated responses remain charged telemetry. UNKNOWN/reserved => UNRESOLVED; infra/capture/timing/caps/incomplete chain => FAIL. Pin policy/prompt hashes in profile/canary/registration/Jev; new discriminator, old pinned and r6 FAIL unchanged.

comparisonContract.executionIdentity: executionId=pairId:arm; taskId retains family. All ledgers/report joins key executionId and attemptId, not task family alone. Twelve independent resets; no workspace, trajectory, feedback or solution transfer across pairs/arms.
comparisonContract.commonPolicy: Same mini, profile, prompt, tools, Docker, verifier, two attempts and budgets. Both arms receive identical bounded failure feedback without verifier source/reference repairs. Infrastructure verifier error is INCONCLUSIVE. Acceptance from mandatory checks; semantic value from Jev.
comparisonContract.corePorts: Reuse createCoreHarness environment/evaluator/sessionStore. Common executor returns candidate-bound facts; actual independent verifier maps to imported VALID/PASS, VALID/GAP, or INCONCLUSIVE/null enums. Atomic store load/save; optional supervisor/context/dosage disabled identically, no synthetic PASS.
comparisonContract.coreLifecycle: SessionId=cohortId:executionId; seed={id:executionId,version:resetDigest}. Observe/act then recordVerification on result candidate, check digest, evaluate and promote only valid PASS changed candidate. No-op keeps identity and never re-promotes baseline. Persist/audit actual events and durable state hash; recovery adopts journaled results once. DIRECT retains common durable acceptance/recovery safeguards.
comparisonContract.metrics: Retain all twelve raw rows and six paired rows with provider calls/tokens/usage certainty, every attempt/check/outcome, active/elapsed/wait and phase times, known/unknown USD, actual human intervals and Core events/storage. Zero denominator => null; no fabricated productivity.
comparisonContract.rubric: Only Jev judges scoped net value. Require complete comparable live and controlled evidence and preserved quality for VALUE_DEMONSTRATED; an attributable benefit in efficiency OR candidate_control OR recovery may justify measured overhead. Efficiency retains V1 20% median active-time gain OR one extra accepted execution, <=10% tokens, and <=10% known positive cost. These thresholds apply only to efficiency, not every value dimension. Candidate control/recovery must exceed unchanged DIRECT safeguards; equal protection is no incremental Core benefit. Jev weighs overhead with no agent/operator weights. Adequate data showing absent or outweighed benefit permits NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED. Missing essential evidence or unresolved confounds requires INCONCLUSIVE. Replay demonstrates only the injected scenario, never field incident prevalence/customer productivity. Unknown infrastructure cost forbids financial claims.
comparisonContract.uncertainty: Show paired observations and descriptive bootstrap interval for median active-time ratio, seed 65074, 10000 resamples; repeated task families and six pairs are explicitly not independent generalization evidence. Missing/zero ratios remain null and cannot be sampled away. Human time is telemetry unless complete; no seven-day or customer holdout claims.
comparisonContract.pilotCompatibility: Preserve existing 20-pair protocol registration and cohort selection as FUTURE_PILOT, never count fixture repeats as held-out customer tasks. Remove agent/code value decisions there too; old numeric thresholds become facts/rubric inputs to a future independently bound Jev evaluation.
comparisonContract.metricSchema: metrics.executions[12]: {executionId,pairId,taskId,repeat,arm,profileHash,promptHash,resetDigest,candidateDigest,attemptCount,terminalReason,checksPassed,checksTotal,accepted,provider:{wireRequests,modelCalls,inputTokens,outputTokens,cachedTokens,usageUnknown,apiUsd},timing:{registeredAt,startedAt,terminalAt,activeMs,providerWaitMs,elapsedMs},overheadUsd,humanIntervals,core:{eventCounts,stateBytes}}. Use null plus reason for unknown fields. metrics.pairs[6] join executionId by pairId, retain both raw rows and computed ratios. accepted means independent mandatory checks all passed, not a value judgment. V2 additionally records cohortId, phase durations (provider active/wait, tool, verification, Core controller/persistence), qualification/probe outcomes and separate controlledTrials with source/trace hashes. Missing executions remain explicit rows with null facts and reason.
comparisonContract.timeAndCost: Active sums measured executor/provider response, verifier and Core work; excludes persisted quota waits only. Elapsed includes queue/waits. Use monotonic intervals with start/stop events; unrecoverable gaps null. Sum all attempts; infrastructure USD only from registered rate, human intervals only actual events.

controlledTrials.method: Frozen deterministic controls through actual production controller/adapter seams; same fault schedule and independent oracle. No model dispatch, no reference repair sent to coding agent. Record current/cited candidate hashes, unsafe finalization, duplicate-effect intents, lost results, recovery work, timings and safeguard owner COMMON or CORE. DIRECT retains all existing checks. Verify failed and inconclusive verifier variants within producer-success trial. Controlled results cannot satisfy 12 live execution requirement.

jevValueContract.authority: Semantic value judgments come only from actual TypeSafe responses. Operator and worker cannot supply choice, select a preferred cached result, modify rubric after outcomes or replace provider error with a choice. Deterministic checks enforce identity/schema/completeness and numeric computation, never author the semantic verdict.

questions.claim: Do actual records establish all twelve live execution outcomes and all twenty-four separately labelled controlled trials with complete traceable accounting?
Are the two arms matched except for the declared real Core treatment, with scope/confounds adequately recorded?
Does ExHarness preserve accepted fixture quality and protected verification boundaries?
Does the observed accepted-outcome/time/token/cost tradeoff satisfy the preregistered fixture-benefit rubric?
Does controlled evidence establish incremental candidate-boundary protection from Core beyond the unchanged DIRECT/shared safeguards?
Does controlled evidence establish incremental recovery benefit from Core beyond unchanged DIRECT/shared safeguards?

stageOne.instructions: Each typed Choice independently reads named facts and rubric, never another same-batch answer. Criteria define SATISFIED as evidence establishes that single claim, CONTRADICTED as adequate evidence refutes it, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as facts missing or unresolved. Confidence is retained telemetry only.

choices.VALUE_DEMONSTRATED: Complete comparable evidence and preserved quality plus attributable efficiency OR candidate-control OR recovery benefit justify measured overhead according to Jev. Efficiency need not be SATISFIED when another benefit justifies overhead.
choices.NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED: Adequate comparable evidence establishes no incremental benefit, worsened quality, or overhead outweighing benefits. Shared safeguards and ties are not Core benefit.
choices.INCONCLUSIVE: Essential evidence/comparability is missing or unresolved confounds prevent a supported scoped conclusion; no availability failure may become a negative value conclusion.

stageTwo.instructions: Jev alone weighs the exact stage-one answers, raw evidence and frozen rubric. Validate typed/schema/binding and prerequisite consistency only; do not encode all-dimensions SATISFIED, force positive from dimensions, reroll, weight choices or substitute agent judgment. Confidence remains telemetry.

jevValueContract.state: Supply immutable registration/rubric; all twelve row-level metrics; independent verification checks; selected bounded original provider request/usage facts and original record hashes; actual Core lifecycle excerpts; all unknowns/failures and denominators; time/order/model identity limitations. Include raw evidence content needed for each claim, not hash-only claims. Deterministically bound excerpts with full-file hashes; exceeding 24000 UTF-8 bytes per stage is an explicit materialization error, not silent dropped coverage. Stage two adds exact stage-one response/hash.
jevValueContract.receipt: Use Node built-in crypto Ed25519, no new dependency. Persist exact redacted request/validated response and detached signed receipt per stage with issuer public-key fingerprint, state/question/rubric hashes, candidate SHA/tree, manifest/profile/evidence root and stage dependency. Final value.json is atomic pointer to stage two. Cache is keyed by all bound inputs and model; signatures revalidated on read. Active controller signing key is outside agent mounts/output; register trusted public key before dispatch. Missing signing key/Jev credential is explicit prerequisite, never an unsigned LIVE receipt.
jevValueContract.trust: The trusted evaluator process, isolated from both coding-agent containers, alone has TYPESAFE_API_KEY and an Ed25519 receipt signing key. Registration pins its trusted public-key fingerprint before any study result; public key is supplied independently to audit, never trusted from the bundle alone. Sign canonical {requestHash,responseHash,model,usage,evidenceRoot,stage,parentReceiptHash} only after callJev returns and validates a real response. Audit verifies Ed25519 signature and all re-materialized input hashes. Mock transport uses a distinct test key and evidenceClass DETERMINISTIC; production audit rejects it. Raw provider request/response and trusted execution provenance remain available to outer Jev; a signature proves controller provenance, not model correctness. No CLI option imports operator judgments or signs arbitrary supplied responses.
jevValueContract.limits: Use existing callJev bounded two transport attempts within 30 seconds per stage, no semantic reroll. Register current price provenance and reserve worst-case 64000 input tokens per stage at documented 0.042 USD/Mtok, output free, observed 2026-09-25; max 0.02 USD covers four wire attempts at that bound. If price changes, require new registered pricing. Count failed/unknown usage conservatively and isolate benchmark-judgment cost from both coding arms while including it in study total.
jevValueContract.completion: VALUE_CONCLUSION requires a valid real definitive Jev result, positive or negative. INCONCLUSIVE routes additional evidence/explicit new authorized cohort while preserving the old one; service unavailable remains a finite prerequisite failure. No claim of delivered benefit is necessary to deliver a trustworthy negative benchmark finding.
jevValueContract.negativeTests: Deterministic doubles never LIVE. Reject tampered evidence, answer/receipt/key/stage substitution, stale candidate, missing/duplicate execution or question. Exact cache replay only; changed evidence cannot reuse receipt. Missing key/429/timeout is unavailable, never a semantic answer.
jevValueContract.evidenceIntegrity: Bind immutable protocol/version/hash, unique cohortId, qualification and fault schedule hashes, exact profile/candidate tree, 12 unique registered executions, 24 controlled trials and trusted preregistered key fingerprint before dispatch and offline audit. Persist failed probes instead of null. Missing rows remain explicit. A derived value pointer is outside signed factual report. Expose receipt-valid separately from benchmark-complete; INCONCLUSIVE never satisfies completion. Preserve V1 audit according to original rubric.

verificationSetup.offline: Use exact registered Node/Python/Playwright dependencies; tests resolve Python from configured executable or python3, not Windows-only paths. Tests have deterministic provider doubles and real local fixture/Core behavior, no real provider dispatch. Fake clocks cover multi-day waits without sleeping.
verificationSetup.live: Worker: all deterministic/regression checks first -> freeze SHA/tree/profile/protocol/policy/prompt/trusted key -> bounded A/B qualification -> one fresh canary -> PASS then exactly one cohort -> 12 LIVE + 24 real-fault controlled -> factual complete audit -> two real Jev stages -> dual export/offline audit. Research calls real readiness Jev only. INCONCLUSIVE is not complete, no reroll or cohort escape. Provider capacity not guaranteed.
verificationSetup.candidate: Commit the exact research publication before worker edits and use that commit as worker baselineSha; researchBaselineSha and implementedSourceSha retain the inspected implementation identity. The candidate includes the exact READY plan/objective, authorized source deltas and Living update. Model route changes require a new cohort. No operator judgment is required.
verificationSetup.evidence: Attach textual pair metrics, Core traces, response attestations, Jev payloads/replies/signatures/trusted-controller provenance and audit logs via contract.claimEvidence. Binary traces are auxiliary; text evidence must suffice for Jev.

researchEvidence.finding: Inspected start/resume, observe, act, recordVerification, evaluate and promote; mutation requires a new candidate identity and promotion requires current VALID/PASS. Reuse around existing mini driver without changing packages.

Six injectable ports provide a development adapter seam; file persistence must implement load/save. Common executor owns external-effect replay safety because Core act alone does not durably reserve provider requests.
Completed failed attempts are skipped; selected-task runs export after every invocation. Existing provider export rejects growing records. Repair journal and projection rather than discard bundles.
Pinned run starts fresh messages, step queries then executes actions, trajectory saved after a step. No durable provider recovery guarantee; keep outer reservations and count a restart as an attempt.
Use state and typed questions with validated answers/usage. Bounded backoff for service rate/overload failures; failure does not supply a judgment.
Choice supplies selected option and distribution; questions in a batch are independent. Final dependent judgment needs a second stage.
Text/JSON structured evidence is supported; screenshots cannot substitute for textual browser observations.
jev-1.13.0 is documented with input-token pricing 0.042 USD/Mtok and 64k total /32k state-plus-longest-question context. Conservative per-stage byte bound avoids unbounded trajectories.
Hosted NVIDIA models can return 429. This is not evidence of the current account quota, nor proof that an ambiguous call is unbilled.
Current user-reported blocker and selected decisions; missing local historic run evidence stays explicit. New study is independently registered.
Two settled probes, second lacked tool_calls; zero measured executions and Jev input providerProbes:null. Real INCONCLUSIVE receipt is not value proof.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: A frozen request-tracker fixture and independent API/browser/persistence verifier preserve the existing three task families and bind every result to exact source, profile and candidate identities.

A finite provider resource and recovery protocol preserves all attempts, costs and unknown usage across quota waits, process restarts and incremental evidence exports without duplicate dispatch or budget resets.

A preregistered six-pair live study compares the current ExHarness Core against direct mini-SWE-agent using the same coding loop, model, tools, prompts, task budgets and independent checks; complete accounting exposes outcomes, time, tokens, calls and total cost.

Only a real, exactly bound Jev evaluation answers whether ExHarness adds value for this fixture/profile under the frozen rubric; missing evidence stays inconclusive, and worker delivery requires all acceptance claims independently SATISFIED.
